sloka: विनीतवीरपुरुषं प्रविश्य तु नृपालयम् ।ददर्शवस्थितम् दीनम् सुमन्त्रमविदूरतः ॥२-३३-२८॥
transliteration: vinītavīrapuruṣaṁ praviśya tu nṛpālayam ।dadarśavasthitam dīnam sumantramavidūrataḥ ॥2-33-28॥

translations.english: Rama entered the royal palace guarded by welltrained warriors and not from very far saw Sumantra who stood a picture of dejection.
